news.title: ECE's Zhu partners with HHS researchers on new nutrition AI tool
news.summary_en: New nutrition AI tools developed by Purdue University researchers could improve how scientists measure diet by capturing eating behaviors in real time instead of relying solely on participants’ recollections.
